intro: NASA's Curiosity rover launched November 26, 2011 atop an Atlas V from Cape Canaveral. After 254 days of cruise, Mars Science Laboratory delivered the 899-kg nuclear-powered rover to Gale Crater on August 6, 2012 via the now-famous sky-crane landing. More than a decade later Curiosity is still climbing Mount Sharp, drilling rocks that hold a record of Mars's once-habitable past.
